recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the bounded current-source cleanup required by FHIR-16769 without over-constraining broad canonical surfaces; any future narrowing of GuidanceResponse.module[x], RequestOrchestration.instantiatesCanonical, or ArtifactAssessment.artifact[x] should use a targeted work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-16769 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 by the CDS work group. It asked whether canonicals should be a special Reference case after CDS/CQI references were changed to canonical URLs, and resolved that canonical tooling support existed and CDS/CQI canonical usages should specify target types.
initial_application: SVN revision 14073, preserved as git commit 3dc81b908557be64248363dc4e5bbf5ed5213965, explicitly applied GF#16769/GF#16765 by ensuring canonical references used qualifiers in knowledge resources. Current ActivityDefinition source already retains targetProfile qualifiers for all canonical elements.
additional_context: FHIR-16949 is the same canonical-qualification family and states that unqualified canonical should be used only when all knowledge/structure resources are valid targets. Later PlanDefinition subject decisions, including FHIR-28432 and FHIR-37485, leave EvidenceVariable as the bounded canonical subject target, while FHIR-49922 added Measure.group.component.measure as a new CQI canonical element whose definition clearly points to Measure. Broader unqualified canonical elements in GuidanceResponse, RequestOrchestration, and ArtifactAssessment were left unchanged because their intended target sets are broad or ambiguous.
reconciliation: Added targetProfile Measure to Measure.group.component.measure, added targetProfile EvidenceVariable to PlanDefinition.action.subject[x], and aligned the PlanDefinition definition-mapping exception to record canonical(EvidenceVariable).
source_changes: source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml: added targetProfile http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/EvidenceVariable to the canonical type on PlanDefinition.action.subject[x].
source/plandefinition/plandefinition-definition-mapping-exceptions.xml: changed the PlanDefinition.action.subject[x] extra type from canonical to canonical(EvidenceVariable).

related_jiras.note: General FHIR-I decision requiring canonical declarations to be qualified unless every knowledge/structure resource is an intended target.
Added canonical subject choices to PlanDefinition and ActivityDefinition for pharmaceutical quality use cases, creating the PlanDefinition action subject context later audited here.
Moved non-canonical product definition targets out of PlanDefinition.subjectCanonical, leaving EvidenceVariable as the bounded canonical subject target.
Added Measure.group.component.measure as an unqualified canonical while moving calculation characterization to Measure.group.
